purpose: Adapt newsletter structure and tone to reader interests while preserving the weekly recap + forecast objective.
adaptationRules: Politics readers get concise accountability framing and clear public consequence.
Business readers get cost, risk, market, and taxpayer consequence before opinion language.
Sports readers get result, preparation, standard, and next matchup pressure.
Technology readers get company action, platform power, privacy/data risk, and public effect.
Local readers get location, official response, resident impact, and next useful update.
nextBehaviorChange: Newsletter Writer reads audience profile before selecting tone, section length, and forecast emphasis.
